definitions.explanation: A decorative design on fabric, paper, or other surfaces.
The size and shape of a person's body.
A person's typical behavior or personality.

notes:
{柄|がら} has multiple related meanings around pattern, build, and character.

SENSE 1 - PATTERN:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧{柄|がら} (floral pattern)
- ⟦{縞|しま}→縞：noentry⟧{柄|がら} (striped pattern)
- ⟦{水玉|みずたま}→水玉：16173_mizutama⟧{柄|がら} (polka dot pattern)
- ⟦{無地|むじ}→無地：03990_muji⟧ (no pattern, solid)

SENSE 2 - BUILD:
- {柄|がら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (large build)
- ⟦{小柄|こがら}→小柄：12362_kogara⟧ (small build)
- ⟦{大柄|おおがら}→大柄：17177_oogara⟧ (large build)

SENSE 3 - CHARACTER:
- 〜{柄|がら}⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧ (not like one's character)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{似合|にあ}わぬ→似合う：02134_niau⟧{柄|がら} (uncharacteristic of ~)
- ⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧ (personality, character)

OTHER READING:
- ⟦{柄|え}→柄：01924_e⟧ = handle (different reading)
